title: SPECIAL USE AND OCCUPANCY
officialText:
1002.1 Compliance with Chapter 4 of the New York City Building Code. Where the character
or use of an existing building or part of an existing building is changed to a special use or
occupancy category subject to Chapter 4 of the New York City Building Code, such building, or
part thereof, shall comply with all of the applicable requirements of Chapter 4 of the New York
City Building Code.
1002.2 Incidental use areas. Where the use of a space is changed to 1 of the incidental uses listed
in Table 509 of the New York City Building Code, such change shall be subject to Section 509 of
the New York City Building Code.
